title: JsonParser fails to parse integers outside the domain of `long`
body:
### Version

4.5.12

### Context

I have a situation similar to

```java
String json = "{ \"big_number\": 18446744073709551615 }";
JsonParser parser = JsonParser.newParser();
parser.handle(Buffer.buffer(json));
```

where Vertx fails to parse the value, throwing a `JsonDecodeException`.

```
io.vertx.core.json.DecodeException: 
Numeric value (18446744073709551615) out of range of long (-9223372036854775808 - 9223372036854775807)
```

Afaik there is nothing in the JSON spec which would prohibit using arbitrarily large numbers.

### Do you have a reproducer?

Yes -> https://github.com/filipkastovsky/stunning-train

### Steps to reproduce

1. Attempt to parse a JSON with an integer that will not fit in `long`, ie. max uint64 - 18446744073709551615
2. The parsing will fail
